run_custom_diffusion_training: run custom diffusion training on a pretrained stable diffusion model with instance images and modifier tokens
create_custom_diffusion_dataset: create a CustomDiffusionDataset that prepares instance and class images with prompts for fine-tuning
build_custom_diffusion_attention_layers: build custom diffusion attention processor layers on a UNet for fine-tuning cross-attention weights
save_custom_diffusion_embeddings: save learned token embeddings from the text encoder to safetensors or PyTorch format
create_model_card: create a model card README with training details, example images, and tags for a custom diffusion model
